title: Gedaliah's Murder and the Flight to Egypt
description: Nebuchadnezzar appoints Gedaliah as governor over the people remaining in Judah. The commanders gather with him at Mizpah, and he promises that they will fare well if they serve the king of Babylon. But in the seventh month, Ishmael, a member of the royal family, arrives with ten men and kills Gedaliah along with the Jews and Chaldeans in Mizpah. Fearing the Chaldeans, all the people flee to Egypt.
